name: howells-plugins
description: Daniel Howells' agent skills as a Claude plugin, listed under a name that claude.ai accounts can add alongside other repos called skills.

plugins.name: howells-skills

plugins.description: Denies the third consecutive poll or wait command when no edit has landed between them.

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Shows model, effort, context used, distance to auto-compact and rate limits above the prompt.
